keySentence: Scrooge cared only for money and nothing else.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A ghost visited Scrooge. It was his old friend Marley. Three more ghosts would come. Scrooge cared only for money and nothing else.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: When Scrooge got home, the ghost of Jacob Marley appeared. Marley dragged heavy chains that he made when he was alive. He warned Scrooge that three ghosts would visit him that night. Scrooge cared only for money and nothing else in his life. The ghost said Scrooge must change or face a terrible fate. Scrooge was frightened but still did not believe it was real.
